description: Express TypeScript API boilerplate with intentionally vulnerable framework configuration, unchecked request types, and reflected response rendering.

vulnerabilities.description: The Express test application exposes the default X-Powered-By header, revealing framework information (Snyk: javascript/DisablePoweredBy/test, CWE-200).
The Express test application exposes the default X-Powered-By header, revealing framework information (Snyk: javascript/DisablePoweredBy/test, CWE-200).
The query filter object's type and filter property are user-controlled without runtime type validation (Snyk: javascript/HTTPSourceWithUncheckedType, CWE-1287).
The query includes object's type and includes property are user-controlled without runtime type validation (Snyk: javascript/HTTPSourceWithUncheckedType, CWE-1287).
The Express application accepts state-changing requests without CSRF protection (Snyk: javascript/UseCsurfForExpress, CWE-352).
An HTTP parameter is rendered directly in a response without adequate output encoding (Snyk: javascript/XSS, CWE-79).
